name: Westmoreland County, PA
findings: Westmoreland County has 1,187 nonprofit organizations. 547 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 441 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Westmoreland County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 25 arts and cultural organizations here list public events, compared with about 11 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do arts and cultural organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.text: 56 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
